wolf_of_wall_street.name: Wolf of Wall Street
wolf_of_wall_street.description: High-energy, excessive confidence, luxury settings, dynamic camera work
wolf_of_wall_street.cinematography_base: High-contrast lighting, warm color grading with golden hour tones, wide aperture (f/1.4-f/2.8), dynamic camera movement
wolf_of_wall_street.camera_style: Steadicam tracking shots, dramatic push-ins, dutch angles for intensity, fast-paced cuts
wolf_of_wall_street.audio_style: Upbeat energetic music, confident voice-over, quick-cut sound design
wolf_of_wall_street.visual_style: Luxurious settings, power dynamics, excessive confidence, wealth signifiers, high-energy editing

tiktok_ugc.name: TikTok UGC
tiktok_ugc.description: Authentic, casual, mobile-first content that feels native to the platform
tiktok_ugc.cinematography_base: Natural lighting, mobile phone aesthetic, vertical 9:16 format, slightly grainy
tiktok_ugc.camera_style: Handheld, selfie-style framing, direct-to-camera address, quick cuts, trending transitions
tiktok_ugc.audio_style: Conversational voice-over, trending audio clips, authentic speaking style
tiktok_ugc.visual_style: Casual settings (bedroom, coffee shop, car), authentic and unpolished, relatable scenarios

wes_anderson.name: Wes Anderson
wes_anderson.description: Perfectly symmetrical, whimsical, pastel colors, quirky and precise
wes_anderson.cinematography_base: Perfectly symmetrical framing, pastel color palette, flat space, static camera, centered composition
wes_anderson.camera_style: Locked-off shots, whip pans, perfectly centered subjects, lateral tracking shots
wes_anderson.audio_style: Whimsical orchestral score, deadpan dialogue delivery, vintage sound effects
wes_anderson.visual_style: Meticulously arranged props, vintage aesthetic, quirky character styling, geometric patterns

documentary.name: Documentary
documentary.description: Authentic, observational, real moments, informative and intimate
documentary.cinematography_base: Natural lighting, realistic color grading, varying focal lengths, observational style
documentary.camera_style: Handheld for intimacy, smooth gimbal for following action, locked-off for interviews
documentary.audio_style: Natural ambient sound, clear voice-over narration, minimal music
documentary.visual_style: Real locations, authentic moments, detail close-ups, environmental context

apple_commercial.name: Apple Commercial
apple_commercial.description: Clean, minimalist, product-focused, aspirational and premium
apple_commercial.cinematography_base: Clean white/minimal backgrounds, perfect product lighting, shallow depth of field, pristine images
apple_commercial.camera_style: Slow smooth movements, macro product shots, reveal moments, perfectly timed transitions
apple_commercial.audio_style: Minimal electronic/piano music, crisp product sounds, occasional warm voice-over
apple_commercial.visual_style: Minimalist environments, focus on product details, white space, premium feel, human moments with product

action_sports.name: Action Sports
action_sports.description: High-energy, dynamic movement, extreme angles, adrenaline-fueled
action_sports.cinematography_base: High shutter speed for crisp action, natural outdoor lighting, wide and ultra-wide lenses, vibrant colors
action_sports.camera_style: GoPro POV shots, drone aerials, slow-motion captures, extreme angles, rapid cuts
action_sports.audio_style: High-energy electronic or rock music, natural action sounds amplified, minimal dialogue
action_sports.visual_style: Outdoor locations, extreme sports, dynamic movement, sweat and effort visible, triumph moments
